definitions.explanation: A newly developed pharmaceutical, especially one recently approved or brought to market.

examples.japanese: {新薬|しんやく}を{開発|かいはつ}する。
その{新薬|しんやく}は{来年|らいねん}{発売|はつばい}される{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: That new drug is scheduled to go on sale next year.

examples.japanese: {新薬|しんやく}の{承認|しょうにん}には{長|なが}い{臨床|りんしょう}{試験|しけん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Approving a new drug requires lengthy clinical trials.

notes:
Common in medical and business news. Contrasts with {既存|きぞん}{薬|やく} (existing drugs).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新薬|しんやく}を{開発|かいはつ}する: to develop a new drug
- {新薬|しんやく}の{承認|しょうにん}: drug approval
- {新薬|しんやく}の{臨床|りんしょう}{試験|しけん}: clinical trial of a new drug

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ジェネリック{医薬品|いやくひん}: generic drug — a cheaper equivalent made after a patent expires
